Decoding the proctitle hex: "dpkg-deb -R /var/www/html/debian/healthcheckd_1.0-1_amd64.deb healthcheckd". The audit records show user "john" (auid=1002) running dpkg-deb, which extracts a Debian package from a web-served directory, and tar performing fchown/fchmod on extracted files, with ownership set to root.

The activity is consistent with a user (or a deployment process) unpacking a .deb package from a web directory as root. This could be a legitimate package inspection or installation, but extracting packages from a web-accessible path and then elevating/changing permissions and ownership on the extracted contents is also a pattern seen in staging malicious payloads. The pattern itself is not conclusive without knowing whether this package is expected.
